query:
SELECT 
            TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('week', moment_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') as week,
            COUNT(*) as count,
            COALESCE(SUM(coins_earned), 0) as coins_earned
         FROM love_moments 
         WHERE couple_id = $1
         GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', moment_date)
         ORDER BY week DESC
         LIMIT 12
